title: Advisory grading deadline through the gateway
description: Replay grading on a disposable gateway with an unresponsive provider transport. Verify cancellation, recorded skip reason, absent grade and preserved worker selection. Run the driver with --negative-control to disable the deadline only in the child gateway and demonstrate the advancement assertion fails.

grade-gateway.intent: Use run.replayStep and run.get through an isolated production gateway to prove an unresponsive grading request is cancelled and the workflow completes grading without replacing the selected worker or fabricating a grade.

no-auth-gateway.intent: Prove grading without API credentials skips explicitly and never launches a CLI fallback; the unchanged summary path uses a fake executable. Run with --no-auth --cli-negative-control to demonstrate the no-fallback assertion fails.
